3

This / That / These / Those

Keep the clear apple visual. No blurry practice pictures underneath.

More practice — SB p.129 ex.3 style

Each item tells you exactly whether to write the singular or plural sentence. The input is full-width, so the complete answer stays visible.

1. Write the plural sentence.

That boy is tired.
that → those · boy → boys · is → are
Those boys are tired.

2. Write the singular sentence.

These jackets are new.
these → this · jackets → jacket · are → is
This jacket is new.

3. Write the plural question.

Is that child in your class?
is → are · that → those · child → children
Are those children in your class?

4. Write the singular question.

Are these boxes heavy?
are → is · these → this · boxes → box
Is this box heavy?

5. Write the plural sentence.

This is a funny photo.
this → these · is → are · photo → photos · remove a
These are funny photos.

5

Who owns what?

Six different owners/pronouns. Each card has its own Hint and Model answer.

📓

I

notebook

Use my before the noun and mine without the noun.
It is my notebook.
The notebook is mine.
📱

You

phone

Use your before the noun and yours without the noun.
It is your phone.
The phone is yours.
📷

Leo

camera

Use his before the noun and his without the noun.
It is his camera.
The camera is his.
🎧

Mia

headphones

Use her before the noun and hers without the noun.
They are her headphones.
The headphones are hers.
🗂️

We

project

Use our before the noun and ours without the noun.
It is our project.
The project is ours.
🛹

Ava & Zoe

skateboard

Use their before the noun and theirs without the noun.
It is their skateboard.
The skateboard is theirs.
